description: All-in delivered cost of a bullion order. Mode 1 (your_quote): give price, quantity, shipping, and payment fee to total your own quote (with below-spot warning if under melt). Mode 2 (dealer_ranking): give a tracked product and quantity to rank US dealers by delivered total using published shipping and payment fees, with per-dealer unavailability reasons and a stale-shipping warning when fee rules are >7 days old. Standard tool free; for a version fine-tuned or customized to your business, email for pricing via https://bullionpricecheck.com/contact/.

payment.description: Mode 2: pay by check/ACH/wire (bank) or credit card.

payment_fee_pct.description: Mode 1: payment method fee as a percent of the item total (for example 3.5 for a card surcharge).

payment_fee_usd.description: Mode 1: flat payment fee in USD (for example a wire fee).

price.description: Mode 1: price per item in USD.

product.description: Tracked product slug or name with its weight (see list_products). Mode 2 when price is not given; in mode 1 it adds per-ounce cost and premium.

shipping.description: Mode 1: shipping charge for the whole order in USD.
